answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The lagoon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zenith is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
